_comment: Wheelchair ramp deployments logged by hand on ride.html, by stop, built by scripts/build_ramp_log.py. Where riders saw the ramp used, not how often it is used.
caveats: Logged by hand by riders on the buses they rode, so it shows where they saw the ramp used, not how often it is used at each stop.
A stop is shown only with 10 or more deployments over 5 or more days.
